verdict.rationale: The evidence only hints at a third-party channel. One Online Account can process multiple filings on multiple entities, which implies a provider could file for many companies. The Revenue site also lists resources for tax professionals and software providers. Neither item documents a formal designee, authorized-provider, or representative mechanism. missing for 10: explicit documentation of registered-agent designation or authorized-representative/designee rails on the SoS filing portal, a defined authorization scope for providers acting for a company, depth beyond link titles, and independent corroboration.
